## Privacy check

GitHub issues are public. Do not attach confidential documents, personal details, full URLs containing tokens, or private document text. Use the repository's synthetic [mixed-page PDF](https://github.com/shinechang1993/pdf-markdown-ocr-checkpoints/blob/main/mixed-text-scan.pdf) or describe the problem without uploading a file.

## Your task

What were you trying to do with the Markdown (for example, move a reading note into Obsidian)?

## Environment

Device, browser and approximate version; PDF text layer or scanned image; Auto or forced English OCR. No device IDs needed.

## Steps and stopping point

Could you choose a file, convert it, inspect the result, and copy or download it? Where did you stop or become unsure? Include any visible error message after removing private information.

## Expected and observed result

Use a short non-sensitive example, or name a checkpoint from the synthetic sample. Please distinguish a raw converter result from your manual repair.

## Follow-up

Would you be willing to answer questions in this public issue? Optional: yes/no. Do not post an email address. We maintain PDFMarkdownKit; this request is for qualitative product feedback, not a conversion-quality benchmark.
